package.name: forklift_safety
package.description: Fail-safe stop for the forklift base. cmd_vel_gate sits between twist_mux and the DiffDrive bridge: it forwards commands while /e_stop is released and fresh, and publishes a zero Twist at once on an e-stop rising edge and repeatedly while the e-stop is engaged or stale or the input is silent. twist_mux only masks inputs and gz DiffDrive keeps the last command, so without this node an e-stop or a GUI crash would leave the robot moving (DECISIONS D-24). Also owns the command chain: config/twist_mux.yaml, config/cmd_vel_gate.yaml and launch/control.launch.py, which forklift_gazebo/sim.launch.py starts by default (D-42).
